tasks: Upload universal, ARM64, and ARMv7 APK artifacts
implementation: Live guide time can follow the device or use Brasília, Manaus, Rio Branco, Fernando de Noronha, or UTC.
The selected time zone is persisted in the existing profile-scoped Live TV channel state and restored after reopening the screen.
Guide grid, Now/Next labels, and source update timestamps use the selected time zone while event instants and playback timing remain unchanged.
Unsupported stored time-zone identifiers fall back to device time; invalid selections are rejected.
unitTestEvidence: Selected JVM tests passed, including LiveTvChannelStateStoreTest for persistent profile-isolated time-zone selection and LiveTvViewModelTest for publishing a saved selection to UI state.
instrumentationEvidence: The Android instrumentation source set compiled; instrumented tests were not executed.
limitations: Debug APKs signed with the CI debug key; not a production release.
Instrumented tests compiled but were not executed on hardware.
No Android TV Box was connected through ADB for physical QA.
